newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends higher, nears key resistance.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends higher, nears key resistance.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed firmer and just below the day's highs, with the March contract creeping closer to key resistance at 10.50 cents.
The spot month drifted on both sides of unchanged throughout the session and then pierced 10.45, where it had stalled several times today, near the close.
Dealers cited speculative and some trade short-covering. Light buying in the March/May spread was also noted.

Trade selling overhead kept March from reaching its near-term resistance target of 10.50 cents, but with volume estimated at 10,226, brisker than it has been for several days, floor sources expect some follow-through Friday.
"We could get more milege on the upside, but good producer selling beginning at 10.48" could limit gains, a dealer said. "Unless we get something in the physical market, why go up?"
Physical offtake remains weak, however, as no new business emerged on the sugar freight market today, brokers said.
March closed 0.04 cent higher at 10.46 cents, traded 10.47 to 10.37. May rose 0.03 on the day to 10.57, while the back months settled 0.02 and 0.01 weaker.
Firm support remained at 10.21, a double bottom on the charts. Sell stops could be triggered underneath, pressuring March to key psychological 10.00 cents, analysts said.
One trader also noted Friday's January options expiry. But he said that because there is no corresponding contract in the futures market, options may expire without affecting futures prices.
